map.药敏导向：结合克拉霉素/甲硝唑/左氧氟沙星耐药状态与青霉素过敏选方案: Susceptibility-guided: choose the regimen from clarithromycin/metronidazole/levofloxacin resistance status and penicillin allergy

map.算法：青霉素过敏且有铋剂 → 铋剂四联（PPI+铋剂+四环素+甲硝唑，或克拉霉素: Algorithm: penicillin allergy with bismuth available → bismuth quadruple therapy (PPI + bismuth + tetracycline + metronidazole, or clarithromycin + metronidazole as substitute); initial treatment with clarithromycin resistance → clarithromycin-free bismuth quadruple therapy / high-dose dual therapy; metronidazole resistance can be overcome by bismuth quadruple therapy; 1 previous failure with levofloxacin susceptibility → levofloxacin-containing quadruple therapy; ≥2 failures → tetracycline/furazolidone regimen or susceptibility-guided therapy. All courses are 14 days.
map.例：青霉素过敏、铋剂可用、克拉霉素敏感 → 铋剂四联（PPI+铋剂+四环素 50: Example: penicillin allergy, bismuth available, clarithromycin susceptible → bismuth quadruple therapy (PPI + bismuth + tetracycline 500mg qid + metronidazole 0.4g tid) for 14 days. If initial treatment, clarithromycin resistant, metronidazole susceptible, no bismuth → avoid clarithromycin and choose concomitant therapy (PPI + amoxicillin + metronidazole + ...) or high-dose dual therapy (esomeprazole 40mg qid + amoxicillin 1g tid) for 14 days.
map.大剂量二联为什么现在受重视？: Why is high-dose dual therapy valued now?
map.大剂量二联（双倍 PPI + 高剂量阿莫西林，常 qid/tid）通过持续抑酸提: High-dose dual therapy (double-dose PPI + high-dose amoxicillin, often qid/tid) raises the intragastric amoxicillin concentration through sustained acid suppression, achieving an eradication rate around 90%, with few antibiotics and few side effects, suiting those who cannot use bismuth or have complex resistance.
map.呋喃唑酮有什么特别注意事项？: What special precautions apply to furazolidone?
map.呋喃唑酮可致双硫仑样反应（服药期间禁酒），长期使用有周围神经病变风险，剂量多为: Furazolidone can cause a disulfiram-like reaction (no alcohol during treatment); long-term use risks peripheral neuropathy. The dose is usually 0.1g bid for 14 days; use cautiously with abnormal liver or kidney function and under physician guidance.

map.例：青霉素过敏、铋剂可用、克拉霉素敏感、甲硝唑敏感 → 输出铋剂四联（PPI+铋: Example: penicillin allergy, bismuth available, clarithromycin-susceptible, metronidazole-susceptible → output bismuth quadruple (PPI + bismuth + tetracycline 500 mg qid + metronidazole 0.4 g tid) for 14 days. If treatment-naive, clarithromycin-resistant, metronidazole-susceptible, bismuth unavailable → exclude regimens containing clarithromycin and those requiring bismuth, keeping only high-dose dual therapy (esomeprazole 40 mg qid + amoxicillin 1 g tid) for 14 days, and suggest additional susceptibility testing.
map.算法：先按药敏/过敏结果建立禁用药物集合（青霉素过敏→阿莫西林；克拉霉素/甲硝唑: Algorithm: first build a set of prohibited drugs from susceptibility/allergy results (penicillin allergy → amoxicillin; clarithromycin/metronidazole/levofloxacin resistance → the corresponding drug), then remove all combinations containing prohibited drugs from the candidate regimen pool and take the top 2-3 by treatment-history priority: treatment-naive favors bismuth quadruple (amoxicillin+clarithromycin, amoxicillin+metronidazole or tetracycline+metronidazole); after 1 prior failure favor levofloxacin quadruple or furazolidone quadruple; after ≥2 failures favor tetracycline+metronidazole, furazolidone quadruple and suggest susceptibility testing. If no regimen survives filtering → prompt for susceptibility guidance/specialist consultation and do not force a recommendation. All courses are 14 days (needs clinical review).
